# Idzharul Huda

> Data infrastructure engineer in Jakarta. Pipelines, BigQuery cost optimization, dbt, and headless reporting.

Idzharul Huda is a data and analytics engineer in Jakarta, Indonesia, working through an independent practice. The practice builds data platforms end to end and rescues the ones already running: ingestion, warehouse modeling, orchestration, and the reports people open every day.

The work is done personally, from the first call to the handover. Engagements usually start from one platform problem, an assessment of something already running, or a delivery that has to land inside the tools a team already uses. The four services on the home page describe how they usually begin.

Alongside client work the practice ships its own products. RaschLab, a platform for Rasch model calibration and item analysis, is the first: in pilot since September 2026, built on an engine checked against Winsteps output for parity on identical input.

## Facts

- Practice: Independent data and analytics engineering practice
- Run by: Idzharul Huda, analytics engineer in Jakarta
- Founded: 2026
- Based in: Jakarta, Indonesia (UTC+7)
- Works in: Indonesian and English
- Products: RaschLab, in pilot since September 2026
- Contact: hello@idzharulhuda.com

## Case studies

- [BigQuery Pipeline Optimization](https://idzharulhuda.com/projects/bigquery-pipeline-optimization.html): A critical datamart query was consuming 96%+ of BigQuery slot time, bottlenecking every report downstream of it and driving cloud cost up.
- [Clinic Incentives Dashboard](https://idzharulhuda.com/projects/clinic-incentives-dashboard.html): Google Apps Script sidebar dashboard bound to a dental practice's cashier workbook: month-filtered KPIs, a revenue trend and a target held in a Config tab, with no write-back.
- [Dataverse - Conversational AI Analytics](https://idzharulhuda.com/projects/dataverse-conversational-ai-analytics.html): Business users needed ad-hoc analysis but lacked SQL skills, so analysts spent hours writing queries for simple questions.
- [DBT + Metabase Self-Serve Analytics](https://idzharulhuda.com/projects/dbt-metabase-self-serve-analytics.html): 15 analysts spent 2+ hours daily running manual reports from Google Sheets.
- [Hourly Incentive Reporting Pipeline](https://idzharulhuda.com/projects/hourly-incentive-reporting-pipeline.html): Multi-source sync that pulls eight SQL cards into one Google Sheets workbook on an hourly trigger, with frozen weeks and audited divergences.
- [Incentive Performance Dashboard](https://idzharulhuda.com/projects/incentive-performance-dashboard.html): Google Apps Script web app over the incentive workbook: pick a week and read per-person and per-team numbers, read-only, with a diagnostics panel instead of silent zeros.
- [Internal Data Request and Catalogue Platform](https://idzharulhuda.com/projects/internal-data-request-platform.html): A platform for teams outside the data function to file, follow and audit data requests, with the asset catalogue and pipeline health in the same place.
- [RaschLab](https://idzharulhuda.com/projects/raschlab.html): A Python toolkit that reproduces a legacy item-response tool's output on real assessment datasets, with every table column gated against committed reference fixtures.
- [Telehealth Cost-Effectiveness Study](https://idzharulhuda.com/projects/telehealth-cost-effectiveness-study.html): A retrospective cost analysis of telehealth-powered managed care against conventional in-person care for acute respiratory infection, published and presented at ICOPH 2024.
